home.faqHomeSubtitle: Everything you need to know to launch your online agenda today.

faqHome.q: Do I need to enter a credit card for the 30-day free trial?
faqHome.a: No. You can create your account and your board in under two minutes without entering payment information. Only if you decide to stay after 30 days do you choose a plan from $5/month.

faqHome.q: Do my clients need to create an account or download an app?
faqHome.a: No. Your clients open your link in any browser, pick an available time slot and confirm with a one-time code sent to their email in seconds.

faqHome.q: How do you prevent two people from booking the same slot at once?
faqHome.a: The instant a client clicks a time slot, the system locks that slot for 10 minutes with database atomic exclusion. No other person can select it.

faqHome.q: Can I embed the appointment schedule on my own website?
faqHome.a: Yes. We provide a responsive, clean embed snippet that you can paste into WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix or custom code with just one line.

items.q: Do my clients need to create an account?
items.a: No. They enter their name and email and confirm with a 6-digit code sent to their email. They can use that same email to see their appointments later.

items.q: How do you prevent double bookings?
items.a: When someone picks a time, we hold it for 10 minutes while they confirm. The database refuses to save two appointments in the same seat at the same time, even if they arrive at the same moment.
Those of about 200 countries and their regions: public, bank, school and optional. You choose which ones block your schedule and can open on a specific holiday.

items.q: Does it work with Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple?

items.q: Can I put it on my website?

English at myappointmentontime.online and Spanish at micitaentiempo.online. Your clients get emails in the language of the site where they book.

items.q: Can my clients see other people's appointments?
items.a: Never. Each client only sees their own appointments. Your team sees what their role allows.

connectAi.seoDescription: Check and manage your schedule from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini using the MCP protocol.
connectAi.title: Connect your AI to your schedule
connectAi.lead: Ask in plain language about your appointments, clients and open times, or have it create, move or cancel an appointment. It works with the open MCP protocol.

assistants.name: Claude
assistants.body: Claude.ai, Claude Desktop and mobile: custom connector.
steps: Open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
Paste the server URL and save.
Click “Connect”, sign in with your My Appointment On Time account and choose permissions and boards.

assistants.name: Claude Code
steps: Run: claude mcp add --transport http my-appointment {{url}}
Inside Claude Code, use /mcp and choose “Authenticate”.

assistants.name: ChatGPT
assistants.body: Developer mode (Business, Enterprise and Edu) or, once published, from the app directory.
steps: Turn on developer mode in Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced.
Create an app with the server URL and OAuth authentication.
Authorize with your account and choose permissions and boards.

assistants.name: Gemini Enterprise
steps: In your dashboard, open AI → Gemini Enterprise credentials and create some.
In Gemini Enterprise: Team → Connected Apps → Add MCP Server.
Paste the server URL, the Client ID and the Client secret.

assistants.name: Gemini CLI
steps: Run /mcp auth my-appointment and authorize with your account.

examples: What appointments do I have tomorrow afternoon?
Move Ana's appointment from Thursday to Friday at the same time.
How many appointments were canceled this month?
connectAi.safetyTitle: You decide what it can do
connectAi.safety: The AI acts with your role's permissions. It asks you to confirm before changing or canceling anything, and you can disconnect it from your dashboard.
connectAi.geminiApp: The consumer Gemini app doesn't support custom MCP servers yet.
